facts: NASA SP-8119 states: "Materials Susceptible to stress corrosion should not be used."
NASA SP-8119 lists 2014-T4 as an alloy/heat-treatment condition susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists 2024 in the standard heat-treated conditions T3, T4, and T351 as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists PH15-7Mo in the conditions RH950 and TH1050 as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists 17-7PH in the annealed condition and H900 condition as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists 17-4PH in the conditions RH950 and TH1050 as susceptible to stress corrosion.
NASA SP-8119 lists AM350 SCT850 and AM355 SCT850 as alloy/heat-treatment entries identified as susceptible to stress corrosion.
